experiment_config.primary_protocol: Within-Session Enrollment/Adaptation Split with Forward Session Evaluation: T0 Pretrain/Enrollment (Sessions 1-4, rep<=20, N=8160, single scaler_pre) -> T1 Adaptation (Sessions 1-4, 21<=rep<=35, N=6120) -> T2 Validation (Sessions 5-6, N=6120) -> T3 Test (Sessions 7-8, N=6120)
experiment_config.secondary_protocol: Strict Session-Sequential Causal Protocol (T0 < T1 < T2 < T3): T0 Pretrain/Enrollment (Sessions 1-2, rep<=40, N=8160, single scaler_pre) -> T1 Adaptation (Sessions 3-4, 21<=rep<=50, N=6120) -> T2 Validation (Sessions 5-6, N=6120) -> T3 Test (Sessions 7-8, N=6120)
experiment_config.scaler: Fixed enrollment scaler_pre fit strictly on T0 pretrain split

strict_session_protocol_benchmark.description: Strict Session-Sequential Causal Protocol (T0 < T1 < T2 < T3): T0 = Sessions 1-2 (rep<=40, N=8160), T1 = Sessions 3-4 (rep 21..50, N=6120), T2 = Sessions 5-6 (rep 21..50, N=6120), T3 = Sessions 7-8 (rep 21..50, N=6120)
